topic: Data Visualization with Matplotlib and Seaborn
learningObjectives: Select suitable charts for different data types and analytical goals.
Create basic visualizations for numerical and categorical data.
Interpret patterns, trends, and relationships from visualizations.

activities.title: Match Charts to Data
activities.instruction: Match each chart type with its appropriate analytical use.

content.concept: Different chart types reveal different patterns, including comparisons, distributions, trends, and relationships.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

choices: Line Chart → Show trends over time
Scatter Plot → Examine relationships between numerical variables
Box Plot → Compare distributions and identify potential outliers

activities.title: Build a Visualization
activities.instruction: Assemble the components needed to create a meaningful chart.

content.concept: A useful visualization combines appropriate data, chart type, labels, and formatting to communicate an analytical result.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Explore Chart Parameters
activities.instruction: Adjust a visualization parameter and observe how the chart changes.

content.concept: Parameters such as histogram bins, figure size, and axis ranges affect how patterns appear in a visualization.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Read the Visualization
activities.instruction: Identify the pattern represented by each visualization.

content.concept: Visualizations help reveal trends, clusters, comparisons, distributions, and relationships that may not be obvious in raw data.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.
